purpose: Compare a disclosed purchase of existing THF with later delivery against buyer-paid immediate atomic settlement.

routes.name: Existing-token purchase with delayed delivery
routes.mechanism: Bilateral documented payment now / delivery of specified existing THF later; no new mint.
routes.cost_note: Buyer can pay network cost to send SOL. Later delivery/refund costs must be budgeted from unrestricted proceeds or sponsored. A receipt/contract does not remove these costs.
routes.custody_risk: Direct receipt puts buyer at issuer delivery/default risk; not trustless escrow or automatically refundable.

terms.quote_asset_preference: native SOL for fee bootstrap; USDC only after token-account costs resolved
terms.uses_of_proceeds: disclosed development/operations, not restricted LP funds

routes.inventory_policy: Reserve exact units once quote agreed; reduce remaining capacity across all routes. Do not double-sell. Existing holder balance is not a vesting lock.

routes.name: Onchain presale with later claims
routes.condition: Exact configuration, buyer rights, refund lifecycle, vesting and third-party setup fee/rent payer verified before deployment.

buyer_disclosures: THF already exists; supply10bn and two treasury-reported wallets held all observed supply at last verification.
No LP or guaranteed secondary market, profit, redemption or future listing.
Learning/gaming are roadmap; fitness is internal testing.
Delayed delivery and refunds depend on exact agreed terms; operating spending may impair refunds unless a reserve is funded.
cash_control: Do not promise unconditional refund while spending the same cash on development. All-or-nothing refundable deposits remain reserved until the success condition. Nonrefundable/risk-bearing funding must be explicitly agreed and eligible, never disguised as guaranteed refundable reservation.
launch_gates: Identify actual eligible buyer and obtain nonbinding indication
Set exact token price/quantity, payment asset and cap, delivery/longstop dates, fees, use of proceeds and failure/refund handling
Review applicable distribution requirements and any required private owner diligence
Verify exact seller control and inventory reservation
Owner authorizes concrete payment/sale terms; any token transfer is owner signed
No Buy button, deposit request or collection address until terms and receipt/reconciliation flow are ready
